## A1 — Constitutional Audit (Layer 0, runs FIRST)

### design.md laws quoted verbatim

**§1 Source of Truth:** `src/index.css` (Tailwind v4 `@theme`) is the single token source. No ad-hoc hex/rgba in component files.

**§2 The Nine Colors:** Monochrome zinc base + one signal hue per surface. Allowed signal hues: amber (time-domain), pink/clay+`--accent-primary` (brand/Focus), cyan (workspace/IDE), emerald (success/filled ONLY), rose (destructive/error ONLY). Categorical data-viz in `src/lib/CategoryColors.ts`. Stray hexes = debt.

**§4 Radii:** `8px` (sm), `12px` (card, max), `9999px` (pill). `rounded-2xl`/`rounded-3xl` banned.

**§5 Categorical Colors:** `src/lib/CategoryColors.ts` is the ONLY place category→color is defined.

**§6 Motion:** Easings `--ease-out-expo` / `cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)`. Durations 150ms/250ms/400ms. No spring overshoot. Page entrance opacity 0→1, y 16→0, 250ms `cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)`. No decorative infinite loops. Honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.

**§7 Anti-Slop Blacklist:** (1) Decorative chrome gradient, (2) more than one signal hue per surface, (3) `backdrop-blur` glassmorphism on chrome, (4) spring/bounce motion, (5) emoji as icons, (6) neon glow, (7) raw hex/rgba in `.tsx`, (8) mixed icon sets, (9) per-component bespoke shadow/radius/border. **Grep gate blocks merge.**

**§8 Per-Page Accent:** `data-page` attribute on `document.documentElement`, components read `var(--page-accent)`.

**§15 Naming:** DeskFlow → RHEO in user-visible strings.

**§10 Pre-Task Checklist:** tokens in `src/index.css`, single signal hue, motion sanctioned easing, reduced-motion, grep gate passes, naming law.

```tsx
{aiAgents.filter(a => a.status !== 'inactive').length > 0 ? (
  <>
    <div className="h-48 mb-6">
      {(() => {
        const activeAgents = aiAgents.filter(a => a.tokens > 0);
        const overviewDays = eachDayOfInterval({ start: subDays(new Date(), 29), end: new Date() });
        const overviewChartData = {
          labels: overviewDays.map(d => format(d, 'MMM dd')),
          datasets: activeAgents.map((agent, idx) => {
            let data = overviewDays.map(d => {
              const dayStr = format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
              return overview?.aiUsage?.byTool?.[agent.id]?.daily?.[dayStr]?.tokens || 0;
            });
            if (excludeOutliers) data = filterOutlierValues(data);
            if (logScale) data = data.map(v => v === 0 ? null : v) as number[];
            return { label: agent.name, data, backgroundColor: agent.color, ...(logScale ? {} : { stack: 'combined' }) };
          })
        };
        const isStacked = !logScale;
        return (
          <Bar data={overviewChartData} options={{
            responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: true, position: 'bottom', labels: { color: '#a1a1aa', padding: 8, usePointStyle: true } },
              tooltip: { backgroundColor: 'rgba(24,24,27,0.95)', titleColor: '#fff', bodyColor: '#a1a1aa', borderColor: '#3f3f46', borderWidth: 1,
                callbacks: { label: (ctx: any) => `${ctx.dataset.label || 'AI'}: ${formatTokens(ctx.parsed.y ?? 0)} tokens` } }
            },
            scales: {
              x: { stacked: isStacked, grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: '#71717a', maxTicksLimit: 7 } },
              y: { type: logScale ? 'logarithmic' as const : 'linear' as const, stacked: isStacked, grid: { color: '#27272a' },
                ticks: { color: '#71717a', callback: (v: any) => v === null ? '' : formatTokens(v) },
                ...(logScale ? {} : { beginAtZero: true })
              }
            }
          }} />
        );
      })()}
    </div>
    {/* agent list follows */}
  </>
) : (
  <EmptyState icon={<Sparkles className="w-12 h-12" />} title="No AI usage data yet" description="Sync AI to start tracking" />
)}
```

### aiAgents derivation (lines 1221-1272) — verbatim

```tsx
const aiAgents = useMemo((): AIAgent[] => {
  const agents: AIAgent[] = [];
  const wsByTool = workspaceAnalytics?.aiUsage?.byTool;
  const ovByTool = overview?.aiUsage?.byTool;
  const byTool = wsByTool && Object.keys(wsByTool).length > 0 ? wsByTool : (ovByTool || {});
  for (const [agentId, data] of Object.entries(byTool)) {
    const config = AGENT_CONFIG[agentId] || { name: agentId, icon: agentId, color: '#6366f1' };
    agents.push({ id: agentId, name: config.name, icon: config.icon, color: getAgentColor(agentId), tokens: (data as any).tokens || 0, tokensIn: (data as any).tokens_in || 0, tokensOut: (data as any).tokens_out || 0, cost: (data as any).cost || 0, sessions: (data as any).sessions || 0, messageCount: (data as any).messageCount || 0, status: (data as any).lastUsed ? 'active' : 'idle', lastUsed: (data as any).lastUsed ? new Date((data as any).lastUsed) : undefined, models: (data as any).models || [] });
  }
  for (const [agentId, config] of Object.entries(AGENT_CONFIG)) {
    if (!byTool[agentId]) { agents.push({ id: agentId, name: config.name, icon: config.icon, color: getAgentColor(agentId), tokens: 0, tokensIn: 0, tokensOut: 0, cost: 0, sessions: 0, messageCount: 0, status: 'inactive', models: [] }); }
  }
  const fp = agents.map(a => `${a.id}:${a.tokens}:${a.sessions}:${a.cost}:${a.messageCount}:${a.status}`).join('|');
  if (fp === aiAgentsFingerprintRef.current) return aiAgentsRef.current;
  aiAgentsFingerprintRef.current = fp;
  aiAgentsRef.current = agents;
  return agents;
}, [workspaceAnalytics?.aiUsage?.byTool, overview?.aiUsage?.byTool]);
```

```tsx
const topToolName = useMemo(() => {
  const byTool = overview?.aiUsage?.byTool || {};
  let best: string | null = null;
  let bestTokens = 0;
  for (const [tool, d] of Object.entries<any>(byTool)) {
    const t = Number(d?.tokens || 0);
    if (t > bestTokens) { bestTokens = t; best = tool; }
  }
  return best;
}, [overview]);
```

## 8 Skill-by-Skill Findings (A1 constitutional override: design.md WINS)

### 1. frontend-external-infra

**Passes:** Uses real shadcn/primitive imports (PageShell, LoadingState, EmptyState, SectionHeader, GlassCard, CurrentCanvas).

**Violations:**
- GlassCard component itself uses `backdrop-blur` — the infra library provides glass; design.md §7 bans it on chrome. Re-skin these two tabs to solid + hairline; GlassCard definition stays for other pages.
- No external component pulls proposed (A6 freeze).

**Recommendation:** Keep PageShell, LoadingState, EmptyState, SectionHeader — they're token-compliant. Replace GlassCard usage in these two tabs with a `Card` primitive using `bg-[var(--color-card)] border border-[var(--color-border)]`.

### 2. frontend-design

**Passes:** Consistent zinc base palette. Token-derived background classes (`bg-zinc-900/80`). Typography hierarchy (text-xl font-semibold → text-sm → text-xs).

**Violations:**
- `backdrop-blur-xl` on cards (lines 1362, 1383, 1515) — §7 #3
- `rounded-xl` (12px) everywhere — §4 max radius is 12px for cards; buttons/inputs should be 8px
- Raw hex colors: `#10b981`/`#a855f7`/`#f59e0b`/`#3b82f6` in stat cards (lines 1356-1359), `#34d399`/`#60a5fa`/`#a78bfa` in language tags (lines 1868) — §1/§7 #7
- `gradient-to-r from-violet-600 to-indigo-600` button — §7 #1
- Mixed signal hues on single surface: overview tab has emerald+violet+amber+blue simultaneously — §2 "one signal hue per surface"

**Recommendation:**
- Cards: `bg-[var(--color-card)] border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)]` + no backdrop-blur
- Radii: cards `rounded-[12px]`, buttons `rounded-[8px]`, page container `rounded-[16px]`
- Stat card colors: route through `CategoryColors` (see A3 table above); replace raw hex with `text-[var(--cat-text)]` + `bg-[var(--cat-bg)]`
- Button: solid `bg-[var(--page-accent)]` with hover `bg-[var(--page-accent)]/80`
- Signal hue:IDE page → cyan `var(--ws-accent)` per §2 ("cyan — workspace/IDE")

### 3. Human-Centric UX

**Passes:** EmptyState for no-data states (projects, AI usage). LoadingState for initial load. Keyboard-accessible buttons (all `<button>` elements).

**Violations:**
- **empty ≠ zero (§4):** `+${fmtNum(codeActivity?.totalLinesAdded || 0)}` renders "+0" when data hasn't loaded — dishonest-by-ambiguity. `fmtSec((codeActivity?.totalDurationMs || 0) / 1000)` renders "0m" for uninitialized data. Same for `overview?.commits?.totalCommits || 0` → "0". (lines 1356-1359)
- **Cognitive overload — Projects card header (lines 1758-1945):** 12+ elements in the collapsed header: project name, path, IDE badge, pencil, chevron, trash, Quick Actions row (3 buttons), Tags row (VCS, languages ×3, health, tools, sessions, repo link). All visible without expansion.
- **Redundant CostValue render:** Lines 1494-1495 render `<CostValue value={agent.cost} />` TWICE — same value, two different formats (currency vs currency), the second is a bug.
- **No 4-state matrix:** overview tab has no explicit loading/empty/error state for the stat grid (lines 1354-1373) — assumes `overview` is always populated.
- **Keyboard:** icon-only buttons (pencil line 1773, chevron line 1779, trash line 1785, chevron in header line 1529) have no `aria-label` — fails accessible name requirement.

**Recommendation:**
- Build 4-state matrix (see A4 table below)
- Fix empty≠zero: `fmtSec(0)` → show "—" when `codeActivity?.totalDurationMs` is undefined/null
- Collapse Projects card: header shows only name + path + IDE badge; Quick Actions + Tags move into expanded content
- Fix duplicate CostValue (line 1495)
- Add `aria-label` to all icon-only buttons

### 4. Impeccable

**Passes:** Consistent dark theme. Good typography scale (text-xl → text-sm → text-xs → text-[10px]).

**Violations:**
- **§Color #11:** Gradient button `from-violet-600 to-indigo-600` — decorative gradient banned
- **§Color #11:** Raw hex `#10b981`/`#a855f7`/`#f59e0b`/`#3b82f6` in stat cards — not token-derived
- **§Motion #16:** `whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}` on functional Add Project button — decorative magnify, banned
- **§Motion #16:** `TAB_LAYOUT_SPRING` on tab indicator — spring in a dev tool
- **§Spatial:** `backdrop-blur-xl` on 3 card surfaces — glassmorphism banned
- **§Typography:** `font-mono` on project paths (line 1766) is correct usage, but path truncation `max-w-[200px]` is hardcoded, not responsive

**Recommendation:**
- Gradient → solid `bg-[var(--page-accent)]`
- Hex stat colors → CategoryColors routing
- Spring → cubic-bezier tween
- Glass → solid + hairline

### 5. Motion — Bring the UI Alive

**Passes:** `AnimatePresence` on tab switches and expanded content. `whileTap` on tabs. Entrance animations on cards.

**Violations:**
- **L2 budget exceeded:** CurrentCanvas (ambient) + tab spring (transitional) + card entrances (entrance) + pulse dot on Stop button (ambient) + scanning bar + hover scale on Add Project = 5-6 layers, exceeds L2
- **`whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}`** on Add Project button (line 1730) — decorative magnify, banned by §6/#4 and §7
- **`TAB_LAYOUT_SPRING`** (line 1336-1338) — spring overshoot banned by §6
- **`duration: 0.2`** on expanded content (line 1955) — hardcoded, should use token duration

**Recommendation (L2 reinterpretation for IDE page):**
- CurrentCanvas: keep, reinterpret to visualize code activity (lines added/removed from `codeActivity` data) — per MEMORY.md §1, The Current is the signature system
- Tab indicator: `transition={{ type: 'tween', duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOutExpo' }}`
- Add Project hover: `bg`/`border` 150ms transition, no scale
- Card entrances: keep pattern, normalize to spec values (opacity 0→1, y 16→0, 250ms `cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)`)
- Reduced-motion: wrap all framer-motion in `useReducedMotion()`

### 6. Design Taste System

**Passes:** Dark zinc base is cohesive. Signal hue (violet) is consistent across the page.

**Violations:**
- **Variance knob:** Too much variance — 4 signal hues on overview tab (emerald+violet+amber+blue stat cards) vs. design.md §2 "one signal hue per surface"
- **Density knob:** Projects tab header is over-dense — 12+ elements in collapsed state
- **Anti-repetition:** Cards use identical `glass` class pattern everywhere — no surface hierarchy

**Recommendation:**
- Reduce variance: IDE page signal hue = cyan (`var(--ws-accent)`), stat cards use CategoryColors (data colors, not signal hues)
- Reduce density: collapse Projects card header to name+path+IDE badge only
- Add surface hierarchy: stat cards `bg-zinc-900/60`, section cards `bg-zinc-900/80`, expanded content `bg-zinc-900/30`

### 7. UI UX Pro Max

**Passes:** Developer-focused UI conventions (monospace paths, tool categories, health scores). Keyboard navigation works (all interactive elements are `<button>`).

**Violations:**
- **Industry rules (§dev tools):** Stats should show rate-per-hour, not just totals — `+120 lines` without time context is meaningless
- **Data density:** Projects tab shows 5 fields in collapsed header (name, path, IDE, actions ×3) — exceeds "3-4 items max" for a compact card
- **Error handling:** `catch {}` on scan failures (lines 1713, 1724) silently swallows errors — no error state for scan

**Recommendation:**
- Add rate context: "lines/hr" derived from `totalDurationMs`
- Collapse project card header to 3 items max
- Add error state for scan failures (non-modal toast or inline banner)

### 8. Taste Skill

**Passes:** Coherent dark theme. Good use of whitespace in expanded content.

**Violations:**
- **Aesthetic monotony:** Overview tab is "soppy" (user's word) — all cards use the same glass pattern, same padding, same border treatment
- **Anti-repetition:** `glass` class applied identically to IDE cards (line 1630), tool categories (line 1662), empty states (line 2069) — no differentiation
- **Signal hue:** Violet page-accent (`#6366f1`) conflicts with IDE's sanctioned cyan signal hue

**Recommendation:**
- Differentiate surfaces: stat cards (compact, no border), section cards (bordered), expanded content (subtle border-top only)
- Change page-accent to cyan `#06b6d4` per §2

## Motion Plan (L2, IDE page reinterpretation)

**Liveliness level:** L2 (Responsive) — IDE page is a dev tool; L1 for stat cards, L2 for interactions

**Reinterpretation of CurrentCanvas:**
- Ties to `codeActivity` data: lines added/removed as flowing particles, duration as particle speed
- NOT decorative — each particle represents a line event
- Color: cyan `var(--ws-accent)` per §2 (IDE surface hue)
- Reduced-motion: disable particles, show static stat summary instead

**Transition spec:**
- Tab indicator: `transition={{ type: 'tween', duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOutExpo' }}` (replaces spring)
- Card entrance: `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: 'easeOutExpo' }}`
- Expanded content: `transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOutExpo' }}` (tokenized)
- Add Project hover: `transition: 'background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease'` (no scale)
- Stat card hover: `border-color 150ms ease` (no scale)

**Reduced motion:**
- Wrap all framer-motion in `useReducedMotion()` hook
- When reduced motion preferred: disable CurrentCanvas particles, show static values, disable entrance animations

**Anti-slop check:**
- No spring/bounce ✓ (replaced with tween)
- No decorative infinite loops ✓ (CurrentCanvas is functional, tied to data)
- No scale transforms on functional buttons ✓
- Transform/opacity only ✓
